S No  Registrar's order with  Signatures  CRLA No. 31 of 2025  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Mr. Mukul Dangi, learned Legal Aid Counsel for the appellant.

2. Mr. V.S. Pal, learned AGA with Mr. Prabhat Kandpal, learned Brief Holder for the State/
respondents.
3. There is delay of 57 days in preferring the appeal.
4. Delay is not seriously opposed by the learned State Counsel.
Therefore, delay in filing the appeal is condoned.

5. Present appeal has been preferred by the appellant (convict) against the judgment and order dated 11.09.2024 and 12.09.2024 passed by learned Special Judge, POCSO Act/ Addl. Session Judge, Khatima, Dehradu in Special Sessions Trial No. 27 of 2022 whereby appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 376, 363, 366A IPC and under Section 5(l)/6 of the POCSO Act with maximum sentence of 10 years.
